collection.title: Honda Civic Hatchback 2012 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Honda Civic Hatchback 2012 - 2015 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Civic Hatchback, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
